newsitem.title: USA: IRS issues option for towns changing use of bonds.
newsitem.headline: IRS issues option for towns changing use of bonds.

text.p: A new IRS procedure released Thursday could spare municipal bondholders when a bond issuer decides to change how it spends proceeds of a tax-exempt financing.

Under the measure, state and local governments that decide to change the use of a bond-financed project midstream can simply pay a certain amount to the Internal Revenue Service, which, in turn, would agree not to declare the bonds taxable, according to the new IRS "revenue procedure."
"But it has a fairly high price," Cross said. "It can be a big number," he said, referring to the amount municipalities that elect to use the procedure would have to pay.
